metadata.title: Da'wah & Guidance Society | Guiding New Muslims in Makkah
metadata.description: A da'wah society in Makkah guiding new Muslims and serving expatriate communities — free Islamic courses, mentorship, and dedicated du'āt in every language.

hero.description: Structured online Islamic courses, mentorship, and a community of new Muslims walking the same path — completely free.
hero.cardText: From shahadah to your first Salah — in your own words, at your own pace.

resource.heading: One Stop Resource Centre for New Muslim Classes Online
resource.body: If you think back to the moment you took your shahada and became a Muslim, you probably felt both excited and nervous all at once. Like the start of any new journey, adopting a new faith identity can feel really overwhelming at first — there are so many different things to learn and implement. That's where the Society comes in. When you join the Society, you'll have access to a great community of people and resources relevant to your needs. Our du'āt are highly qualified and have been teaching Islam to expatriate communities for many years. You'll be able to learn new things about the faith, engage in discussions with fellow new Muslims, and access a long list of experienced teachers and mentors. So join now and get started.

features.heading: Everything you need on your journey
features.subheading: From your first prayer to your first Ramadan and beyond — every step, supported.

card1.title: Video Classes & Webinars
card1.body: Super FUN & STRUCTURED curriculum. Mentors that CARE for you & WILL be there for you. Weekly discussions & academic challenges. Meet & celebrate with other new Muslims.

card2.title: Personal Members Portal
card2.body: Direct access to resource videos, live classes, and a supportive community of new Muslims, specialized teachers, and qualified mentors. They've all got your back at this critical stage of your life.

card3.title: Live Interaction
card3.body: Direct access to all of our instructors — you will never be alone. Our online resource tools provide unique, unparalleled access to a community filled with individuals like yourself.

free.heading: It's 100% Free
free.badgeText: Thanks to generous donors, we're able to meet our high professional standards of service while keeping it all FREE for you. All we ask is that you pray for us too :)

items.quote: The Society has filled a void that life can leave. Once I testified my Shahadah, even though I wanted to drop everything and move into a mosque (figuratively) to learn as much as possible, the constraints of life continued with work and my family. The Society has provided an opportunity to still get more knowledge than the weekly Khutbahs and self study of the Qur'an can provide.
items.author: Chris

items.quote: The mentors at the Society truly care. They answered every question I had without judgment and guided me through my first Ramadan with patience and wisdom.
items.author: Adam

items.quote: I felt so alone after converting. NMA gave me a family — brothers and sisters who understand exactly what I'm going through.
items.author: David

items.quote: The structured curriculum gave me a roadmap when I had no idea where to start. Six months in and I'm praying five times a day with confidence.
items.author: Marco

story.title: Our Story
story.body: Since 1413H, the Da'wah & Guidance Society in Makkah has carried one mission: to convey Islam clearly and serve the expatriate communities who live in the shadow of the Sacred House. Through dedicated du'āt who teach in Amharic, Burmese, Urdu, Filipino and Indonesian, the Society walks beside the new Muslim — from a first shahadah to a confident, practising faith. Every course, every session, free.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: A leading beacon of da'wah, spreading the Prophetic guidance.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: A civil da'wah society that calls to Islam and guides to the truth through impactful, high-quality programs and advanced, varied technical methods — delivered by a creative team in a welcoming environment.
